nodes.title: SG-8.3.3 Rewrite the repo-root context.md to the real stack and modules
nodes.body:
Context: context.md still describes a README-only repo. The helpers docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts and four test files (contextStack, contextPaths, contextDoc, docsCheck) already exist in game/frontend. Desired behavior: context.md names TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix and Vitest, marks the Go backend out of scope, and has a module table covering game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/. Expected result: the 9 failing context.md unit tests pass. Why: the master index must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given context.md, when missingTerms runs with STACK_TERMS, then it returns [].
- Given context.md, when staleTextHits runs, then it returns [] and the text has no UNKNOWN.
- Given the module table, when contextModulePaths and missingPaths run against the repo root, then all four required paths are listed and none is missing.


## Scope
- In scope: context.md Purpose, Stack, Modules, Entry points, Workflows, Scan meta and Residual unknowns text
- In scope: reference to game/docs/GDD.md
- Out of scope: backend/ Go changes
- Out of scope: new game features
- Out of scope: GDD content changes
- Preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0 pin
- Preserve: game/src never imports game/frontend
- Preserve: no source file over 200 lines


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- backend/ (Go) is out of scope
- No test is deleted or skipped
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- The 9 context.md unit tests pass
- npm test and npm run typecheck stay green


## Clarifying questions
- None

- Given a path in a non-table line, when contextModulePaths runs, then it is not returned.
